answer: Agents trading walnut lumber, trellis kits, and willow baskets must each lock a fixed bond for 30 days before receiving a daily transaction quota. Quotas scale only with the total capital locked, so splitting funds among fake identities creates no extra capacity. Running 1,000 funded identities requires 1,000 bonds, tying up capital and exposing the attacker to its price risk. This makes mass participation costly without pretending that a bond proves personhood.
